_comment: GRADED SIZE SPECIFICATION — the chart issued to the manufacturer and produced against. Single source of truth for every size table on the site. Sizes S–XL only — we do not produce XXL. Rows: [size, chest_in, chest_cm, length_in, length_cm, shoulder_in, shoulder_cm, sleeve_in, sleeve_cm].
confirmedNote: Production spec issued to InkMASH on the purchase order. Supersedes any supplier standard chart.
regularIntent: Classic regular fit to the US/international standard, with a 2″ chest step per size above M. The shoulder seam sits at your natural shoulder point.
oversizedIntent: A true drop-shoulder oversized cut — the shoulder seam sits 2–3″ below the natural shoulder point. Width, not length, is what creates the silhouette, so it does not simply wear like a size up.
method: Chest — garment laid flat, measured straight across from armhole seam to armhole seam (pit‑to‑pit), 1″ below the armhole.
Length — from the highest point of the shoulder, at the collar seam, straight down to the bottom hem.
Shoulder — seam to seam across the back, between the shoulder seam points.
Sleeve — from the shoulder seam to the sleeve opening edge.
tolerance: Tolerance is ±0.5″ (±1.3 cm) on every measurement. Garments outside that are rejected at QC.

polo.note: The polo is graded to the same specification as the tees. Take the Regular fit measurements above — the polo has a set‑in sleeve and no drop shoulder, so the oversized chart does not apply to it.
